'''Daetan Taakses''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Pinett]] with his nephew, [[Oryel Taakses]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the rival trading concerns the [[Corsignis Property Alliance]] and the [[Jon-Tow Economic Development Group]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Pinett as a result of a dispute, Taakses became the leader of the [[Pinett Freedom Force]], a protest group that campaigned against the blockade. The Freedom Force attempted to prevent Corsignis and Jon-Tow from landing on Pinett and Taakses went on a hunger strike, as an act of protest. However, a group of port workers became disgruntled as a result of the Freedom Force's actions and they attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Taakses.
